import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
ax = sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, palette='pastel')

# Set labels and title
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot

import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load the dataset
data = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Set the style of seaborn
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a boxplot to visualize the distribution of sleep duration by BMI Category
plt.figure(figsize=(12, 8))
ax = sns.boxplot(x='BMI Category', y='Sleep Duration', data=data, palette='pastel')

# Set labels and title
ax.set_title('Distribution of Sleep Duration by BMI Category', fontsize=16)
ax.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=12)
ax.set_ylabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=12)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
